headline: Fed Governor Barr Warns AI Agents Could Trigger Rapid Bank Runs
summary: Federal Reserve Governor Michael Barr stated that automated financial agents could potentially trigger bank runs within minutes by overwhelming systems and bypassing security controls.
why: This highlights growing regulatory concern regarding the integration of artificial intelligence into financial systems and the potential for systemic instability in the banking sector.

impacts.name: Banking
impacts.why: Regulatory warnings about AI-driven bank runs may lead to stricter oversight of financial technology.
